about: Measured from the render: x_screen/y_screen are the alpha-weighted centroid of the composited dog layer; x_measured_m maps it back through x = (x_screen - 372) / 185. facing comes from the archive frame and the mirror flag (structural, not measured from pixels). posture is lying when the fold composite has lie > 0.5. frac_inside_door_frame is the share of dog alpha left of the door frame's outer edge (x = 0.46 m). head_height_px is the highest alpha point in the front 28% of the body (the head end), above the ground line.
